subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What are the prime factors of 30?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! 30 ke prime factors kya hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Can 144 laddoos be packed in boxes of 9 with none left over?
prompt_hi: Kya 144 laddoo 9-9 ke dabbon mein bina koi bache pack ho sakte hain?
answer: Yes: digit sum 1 + 4 + 4 = 9, and 144 ÷ 9 = 16

subject: maths
prompt_en: Is 316 divisible by 4?
prompt_hi: Kya 316, 4 se divide hota hai?
answer: Yes: the last two digits, 16, are divisible by 4 (316 = 4 × 79)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict, then check: is 34 divisible by 4? Is 1024?
prompt_hi: Pehle guess karo, phir check karo: kya 34, 4 se divide hota hai? 1024?
answer: 34: no (34 ÷ 4 = 8 remainder 2). 1024: yes (24 is divisible by 4; 1024 = 4 × 256)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Sonu says 23 is divisible by 3 because it ends in 3. Check.
prompt_hi: Sonu kehta hai 23, 3 se divide hota hai kyunki yeh 3 pe khatam hota hai. Check karo.
answer: No: the digit sum is 5, not a multiple of 3; 23 is prime

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why do we only need to check the last two digits to test for 4?
prompt_hi: 4 ka test karne ke liye sirf aakhri do digits kyon check karte hain?
answer: Every hundred is divisible by 4 (100 = 4 × 25), so the hundreds and thousands part never leaves a remainder; only the last two digits can

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why does the digit-sum test work for 9?
prompt_hi: 9 ke liye digit-sum test kyon kaam karta hai?
answer: 10 = 9 + 1, 100 = 99 + 1, 1000 = 999 + 1, so each digit gives a multiple of 9 plus the digit itself; the number leaves the same remainder as its digit sum

subject: maths
prompt_en: 12 and 18 are both divisible by 3. Are both divisible by 9?
prompt_hi: 12 aur 18 dono 3 se divide hote hain. Kya dono 9 se bhi hote hain?
answer: No: 18 is (digit sum 9) but 12 is not (digit sum 3)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Is 5128 divisible by 8?
prompt_hi: Kya 5128, 8 se divide hota hai?
answer: Yes: the last three digits, 128, are 8 × 16

subject: maths
prompt_en: A school has 1236 students. Can they be put into equal groups of 3? Of 4? Of 9?
prompt_hi: Ek school mein 1236 students hain. Kya inhe 3-3 ke barabar groups mein baant sakte hain? 4-4 mein? 9-9 mein?
answer: 3: yes (digit sum 12; 412 groups). 4: yes (36 is divisible by 4; 309 groups). 9: no (digit sum 12 is not a multiple of 9)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Fill the missing digit: 47_ is divisible by 9. What is the digit?
prompt_hi: Khaali digit bharo: 47_ , 9 se divide hota hai. Digit kya hai?
answer: 7 (477; digit sum 18)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend the divisibility tests for 2, 3, 4 and 5 in one minute.
prompt_hi: Dost ko ek minute mein 2, 3, 4 aur 5 ke divisibility tests sikhao.
answer: 2: last digit even. 3: digit sum divisible by 3. 4: last two digits divisible by 4. 5: last digit 0 or 5

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! Which digits can a number divisible by 5 end with?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! 5 se divide hone wala number kin digits pe khatam ho sakta hai?
answer: 0 or 5

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangle is 8 cm by 5 cm. What is its perimeter?
prompt_hi: Ek rectangle 8 cm by 5 cm ka hai. Iska perimeter kya hai?
answer: 26 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: A square has side 7 m. What is its perimeter?
prompt_hi: Ek square ki side 7 m hai. Iska perimeter kya hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: For a 12 m by 7 m garden, Raj says the perimeter is 19 m. Fix his answer.
prompt_hi: 12 m by 7 m ke garden ke liye Raj kehta hai perimeter 19 m hai. Uska answer theek karo.
answer: 38 m: he added only two of the four sides; 2 × (12 + 7) = 38

subject: maths
prompt_en: A square has side 5 cm. If you double the side, predict what happens to the perimeter.
prompt_hi: Ek square ki side 5 cm hai. Side dugni karo toh perimeter ka kya hoga, guess karo.
answer: It doubles too, from 20 cm to 40 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why does the rectangle formula say 2 × (length + breadth)?
prompt_hi: Rectangle ka formula 2 × (length + breadth) kyon kehta hai?
answer: A rectangle has two equal lengths and two equal breadths; going once round adds length + breadth twice

subject: maths
prompt_en: A square park has a perimeter of 400 m. How long is one side?
prompt_hi: Ek square park ka perimeter 400 m hai. Ek side kitni lambi hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: You fence a vegetable patch 15 m by 10 m with wire costing ₹25 per metre. What does it cost? What if a 2 m gate needs no wire?
prompt_hi: 15 m by 10 m ki sabzi ki kyari pe ₹25 per metre wali taar lagani hai. Kitna kharcha? Agar 2 m ke gate pe taar na lage toh?
answer: ₹1250 for the full 50 m; ₹1200 with the gate (48 m)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Putting lace around a tablecloth and covering a table with the cloth: which needs perimeter, which needs area?
prompt_hi: Tablecloth ke chaaron taraf lace lagana aur table ko cloth se dhakna: kisme perimeter chahiye, kisme area?
answer: Lace around the edge needs perimeter; covering the table needs area

subject: maths
prompt_en: An L-shaped room has sides 6, 2, 3, 2, 3 and 4 m. Riya added 6 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 = 16 m. What did she miss?
prompt_hi: Ek L-shape kamre ki sides 6, 2, 3, 2, 3 aur 4 m hain. Riya ne 6 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 = 16 m joda. Usne kya chhoda?
answer: The last side of 4 m; the perimeter is 20 m

subject: maths
prompt_en: Turn this walk into a shape and a formula: walk 30 m, turn, 20 m, turn, 30 m, turn, 20 m back to the start. How far did you walk?
prompt_hi: Is walk ko shape aur formula mein badlo: 30 m chalo, mudo, 20 m, mudo, 30 m, mudo, 20 m wapas shuru tak. Kitna chale?
answer: A 30 by 20 rectangle; 2 × (30 + 20) = 100 m

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach your friend how to find the perimeter of any rectangle, and why you can't just add length and breadth.
prompt_hi: Dost ko sikhao kisi bhi rectangle ka perimeter kaise nikalte hain, aur sirf length aur breadth jodna kyon galat hai.
answer: Add all four sides, or use 2 × (length + breadth); adding length and breadth once covers only half the boundary

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What is the perimeter of a square with side 9 cm?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! 9 cm side wale square ka perimeter kya hai?
answer: 36 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangle is 9 cm by 4 cm. What is its area?
prompt_hi: Ek rectangle 9 cm by 4 cm ka hai. Iska area kya hai?
answer: 36 sq cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: A square has side 6 m. What is its area?
prompt_hi: Ek square ki side 6 m hai. Iska area kya hai?
answer: 36 sq m

subject: maths
prompt_en: A 6 by 2 rectangle and a 4 by 4 square both have a perimeter of 16. Predict: do they have the same area?
prompt_hi: 6 by 2 ka rectangle aur 4 by 4 ka square, dono ka perimeter 16 hai. Guess karo: kya area bhi barabar hai?
answer: No: 12 square units versus 16 square units

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why is the area of a rectangle length × breadth?
prompt_hi: Rectangle ka area length × breadth kyon hota hai?
answer: The rectangle holds 'length' unit squares in each row and there are 'breadth' rows, so counting rows × squares per row gives the total

subject: maths
prompt_en: Arjun wrote the area of a 5 cm by 3 cm card as '15 cm'. What is wrong?
prompt_hi: Arjun ne 5 cm by 3 cm card ka area '15 cm' likha. Kya galat hai?
answer: The number is right but the unit should be square cm: 15 sq cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Pooja found the area of a 7 m by 5 m room by adding 7 + 5 + 7 + 5 = 24. What did she find instead?
prompt_hi: Pooja ne 7 m by 5 m kamre ka area 7 + 5 + 7 + 5 = 24 jodkar nikala. Usne asal mein kya nikala?
answer: The perimeter (24 m); the area is 7 × 5 = 35 sq m

subject: maths
prompt_en: A room floor is 4 m by 3 m. Square tiles are 50 cm by 50 cm. How many tiles are needed?
prompt_hi: Ek kamre ka floor 4 m by 3 m hai. Square tiles 50 cm by 50 cm ki hain. Kitni tiles chahiye?
answer: 48 tiles (8 along the length × 6 along the breadth)

subject: maths
prompt_en: You have 24 m of fencing. Which rectangle with whole-metre sides gives the biggest garden?
prompt_hi: Tumhare paas 24 m fencing hai. Poore metre ki sides wala kaunsa rectangle sabse bada garden dega?
answer: 6 m by 6 m, area 36 sq m

subject: maths
prompt_en: A 1 by 12 strip and a 3 by 4 rectangle. Same area? Same perimeter?
prompt_hi: 1 by 12 ki patti aur 3 by 4 ka rectangle. Area barabar? Perimeter barabar?
answer: Same area (12 square units); different perimeters (26 and 14)

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangle has area 24 sq cm. Give three different whole-number rectangles it could be.
prompt_hi: Ek rectangle ka area 24 sq cm hai. Poore numbers wale 3 alag rectangles batao.
answer: For example 1 × 24, 2 × 12, 3 × 8, 4 × 6 (any three)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend the difference between area and perimeter using a room in your house.
prompt_hi: Ghar ke ek kamre ka example lekar dost ko area aur perimeter ka fark sikhao.
answer: Perimeter is the distance around the walls (add the sides, in m); area is the floor covered (length × breadth, in sq m), like tiles or a carpet

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! What is the area of a square with side 10 cm?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! 10 cm side wale square ka area?
answer: 100 sq cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: A rectangle 8 cm by 6 cm is cut along a diagonal. What is the area of one triangle?
prompt_hi: 8 cm by 6 cm ka rectangle diagonal se kaata gaya. Ek triangle ka area kya hai?
answer: 24 sq cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: A right-angled triangle has 10 m and 4 m as the sides around the right angle. What is its area?
prompt_hi: Ek right-angled triangle ki right angle wali do sides 10 m aur 4 m hain. Iska area kya hai?
answer: 20 sq m

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why is the triangle exactly half the rectangle, not a bit more or less?
prompt_hi: Triangle rectangle ka theek aadha kyon hai, thoda zyada ya kam kyon nahi?
answer: The two triangles are identical: one turned around fits exactly on the other, so they share the rectangle equally
